rationale.consistency: Follows the existing per-option special-case pattern in evaluateGlobalOptionsBlock, same error wrapping, gofmt-aligned struct literals; Helper field kept unexported so no API change.
rationale.edge_cases: Invalid order errors out with nothing written to globals or options; multiple order lines chain via the local slice; plugin RegisterDirectiveOrder still visible since each adaptation clones directiveOrder.
rationale.scope: Threads order through Helper/buildSubroute/sortRoutes as needed; also moves named_routes out of the options map, which is justified by the shared-options concurrency requirement but slightly widens the diff.
rationale.readability: Clear comments on why order stays out of options; the redundant configuredNamedRoutes alias and the now-stale comment on the global directiveOrder var are minor blemishes.
rationale.robustness: No locks, no global mutation, slices cloned before DeleteFunc/Insert, type assertion checked; nil existingVal degrades gracefully rather than panicking.
rationale.maintainability: Explicit data flow replaces hidden coupling through the options map, though serversFromPairings now takes seven params and extractNamedRoutes returns four values.
